This fucker just yanked out all the stuff I picked up from my hands!
You: Wha?! I just wanted to help?!
Landlord: Y-you did? Well, that’s unexpected.
Landlord: Th-{{wi}} Th-th-th-{{wi}} Thaaaa…{{wi}}...nks…
Well, that must have been hard for him.
You: You are welcome.
Landlord: Listen, you saved my skin here, but do not expect any special treatment!
Landlord: And don’t act so smug about it!
